mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT A.ODAPL_POP_CD AS odaplPopCd, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'MD00017' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.ODAPL_POP_CD) AS odaplPopNm, A.FSR_STF_NO AS fsrStfNo, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.FSR_STF_NO) AS fsrStfNm FROM ODS.S_MOOORPTD A WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.MED_PACT_TP_CD = #{medPactTpCd} AND A.ORD_DT::DATE = #{ordDt}::DATE AND A.ORD_CTG_CD NOT IN ('TRM') ORDER BY A.ODAPL_POP_CD, fsrStfNm
